name: Cinderella
source:
The main character of one of Grimm's Fairy Tales: "The Little Ash Girl".

Serious, introverted, and quite a hard worker, she goes beyond her usual role in the story. She works as a maid, a cook, and a cleaner in her own home and at the castle.

As Cinderella, she strives to be perfect and live up to her name. Perhaps because of the influence of the older version of Grimm's Fairy Tales, she is always on the move to the point of being obsequious, a very busy girl. Has a habit of solving trivial problems as soon as possible.

Only after she's done will she sport a bold smile on her face.

"If it gets dirty, just wash it. It's not a problem, because doing laundry is my job."

[Edited from [url=http://yumemiru.nexton-net.jp/gbm-grimm/package/#character]Official Website[/url]]
